posts.author: Lionbarrel
posts.body:
So, least liked Monster Hugger has gotten around to get her grubby hands on RPG maker Unite. Only for 20 five bucks would a surprise!! The reasoning though is more for archival purposes and wanted to see what they made inside the game I was already warned about how badly it would to be making any kind of game, but I do love snatching up assets. While looking for more assets that are usable and unique to said engine, it looks like they left remained of another project or the original this project!!
Now when I said scraps I actually meant there are a lot of images from previous projects I'm not too sure since I'm not familiar with an engine can make As another engine obviously as somebody that is using RPG maker I'm not all aware about coding especially on how one goes about making engines with another engine, but it is possible for sure... So anyway if you're ever wondering why it takes so long or your stuff to upload or Why said engine is known for not only bad performance but being heavily bloated all these images that you come across; these are just a few, come with metadata there are also a bunch of icons and seemingly Progression screenshots... interesting to see for sure But it does bring the question of why You would spend so much money originally like 100 and something dollars to purchase for such a Coupled up engine. I got what I wanted from this which was the assets and music that was original big surprise besides the background music most everything else was from Mz?? MV??? Especially most of the other sprite works there are not a lot of original tiles and even some of the enemies are similar and recolored to give the illusion Of having a lot of monsters. You don't even get like all the evil characters fighting sprites/enemies sprites, which is crazy!!!
But unfortunately all these funny looking characters you do find have already become not my characters, but I am and adopting them, and make them like fan characters of Unite or something similar...
